en.title: The Blacksmith's Son Who Lit Up the Planet ⚡ #Shorts
en.description:
In 1831 Faraday, a blacksmith's son who left school early and worked as a bookbinder's apprentice, found that a moving magnet pushes the electrons in a wire. Most of the planet's electricity is still made that way.

The full report: How Is Electricity Made? Every Station Does the Same Thing | Electricity File 2
